verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents a full, comprehensive public REST API with API-key auth, endpoints for accounts, ACH, wires, book transfers, cards, webhooks, KYC, and a sandbox for testing, plus a Postman collection and llms.txt discovery page — clearly enabling programmatic/AI-native driving of the product. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404), which would strengthen agentic tooling integration.
